sections.label: Glassware
lines: 1O oz Mug rimmed with Red, White, Blue Sugar

sections.label: Recipe
lines: Combine soft serve shake and Finest Call blue curacao in mixing tin. Mix for 5 seconds using the spindle mixer. Pour into 10 oz mug rimmed with red, white, and blue sugars. Top with strawberry puree and whipped cream. Sprinkle 1 tsp red, white, and blue sugars. Garnish with cherry.

sections.label: Glassware
lines: 16 oz Pint Glass rimmed with Graham Cracker Crumbs

sections.label: Recipe
lines: Combine frozen rita, soft serve shake, and tequila in mixing tin. Mix for 5 seconds using the spindle mixer. Pour into pint glass rimmed with graham cracker crumbs. Top with whipped cream and sprinkle 1 tbsp graham cracker crumbs. Garnish with lime wedge and cherry.

sections.label: Glassware
lines: 16 oz Pint Glass rimmed with Red, White, Blue Sugar

sections.label: Recipe
lines: Combine frozen rita, soft serve shake, and blue curacao in mixing tin. Mix for 5 seconds using the spindle mixer. Pour into pint glass rimmed with sugars. Top with strawberry puree, whipped cream and sprinkle 1 tsp red, white, and blue sugars. Garnish with a cherry.
